name: When should I consider custom built-ins versus pre-fabricated options for my ADU?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider custom built-ins versus pre-fabricated options for my ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider custom built-ins when you have specific design requirements, unusual space dimensions, or a desire for a truly unique aesthetic that pre-fabricated options cannot meet. Custom solutions offer optimized storage and seamless integration with the ADU's architecture. Pre-fabricated options, conversely, are typically more budget-friendly and have shorter lead times. The practical tradeoff is often between bespoke design and cost efficiency, and we can help assess which approach best fits your project goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose custom built-ins for unique designs or challenging spaces, and pre-fabricated for budget-friendliness and quicker timelines. It's a tradeoff between design and cost.
